theme.description: Tactile warm graph-paper/college notebook vibe, playful hand-drawn charcoal lines, subtle washi tape, organic highlighter swatches, and squiggly SVG doodles. Feels like a student community bulletin board rather than a sterile SaaS.

hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight font-display

colors.guidelines: Never use pure #000000; always use warm charcoal #1E1E1E. Single punchy primary accent is Campus Terracotta (#E05A36) balanced with soft highlighter tints and warm graph notebook backdrop.

Header.description: Sticky top bar with Lostly hand-drawn logo, slogan 'Campus Lost & Found, peer powered', view toggle (Report vs Browse Board), and active lost counter badge

ReportFlow.description: Conversational 4-step card with back/next controls, progress pills, lively doodle accents, and instant submission into localStorage

ItemsBoard.description: Search input, category pill filters, status filters (All | Missing | Found), item grid, empty state with sketch doodles

ItemCard.description: Sketch card with washi tape/pin doodle, category badge, time/location clues, found toggle, and clue list

ClueModal.description: Where do you think they should look? modal dialog with hand-drawn styling and immediate clue posting

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts (Caveat, Plus Jakarta Sans, Space Mono) in index.html or index.css for authentic notebook doodle typography.
Implement the 4-step reporting flow on first open so the user is immediately prompted with conversational questions.
Store all items and clues in browser localStorage using key 'lostly_items_v1' and seed with provided sample items if empty.
Ensure the 'I might know something' modal allows typing location clues and appends them to the corresponding item immediately.
Ensure item status can be toggled between 'Still Missing' and 'Found ✓' with distinct visual styling (green tint, check badge, strikethrough/dimmed title).
Include playful SVG doodle accents (paperclip, wobbly underlines, pin mark, hand-drawn arrows) to satisfy the 'sketchy with doodles' user choice.
Verify all interactive buttons, inputs, and toggles have required data-testid attributes.
